content: The function FrIf_CancelAbsoluteTimer shall wrap the FlexRay Driver API function Fr_CancelAbsoluteTimer() by: 1. Translating (based on static FrIf module configuration) the FlexRay CC index Fr If_CtrlIdx into a tuple (FlexRay Driver | Driver-specific CC index Fr_CtrlIdx). 2. Setting parameters Fr_AbsTimerIdx to FrIf_AbsTimerIdx 3. Calling Fr_CancleAbsoluteTimer() of the determined FlexRay Driver module with the parameters determined as described above.
